help: The mountains drift on their own. Each ridge answers its own range, from the highest sounds in the farthest ridge to deep bass in the nearest, and sharp hits leave light traces. Bass and low hits make the sun and its corona glow.

Bass drives magenta fixtures, mids drive cyan windows, high mids drive the left cyan panel, and treble drives violet accents. Low hits send light across the bridge, and overall intensity lights the distant gate and haze.
Lights follow the music with quick, smooth transitions. The distant gate and haze follow overall intensity.
Travel stays steady, even in silence. Low hits pulse the sun; low mids light the contours and high mids send brief streaks. Move the mouse to look around.
